nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Shield Invisible Blemish Protectant

avis.texte: I don't ever leave reviews but this product is bad. It states it can be worn under makeup but it absolutely cannot. It peels so badly. I have tried to use it 4 separate days making sure to have completely dry skin and apply my skincare on top once the product dries but every time it looks like literallt peeling skin. It is definitely not good for the mouth and chin area. To me this product feels like false advertisement. This is all very discouraging due to the high price point. Save your money.

So I never make reviews, but I also don't buy a lot of things, but I do buy them for what they state to provide on their label, which was you could wear this product underneath makeup. You can absolutely not do that, it will peel. And then once it does peel, while you're out in public, you have a whole splotch of just like red or You'll see your pimple or whatever it does work well for inside of the home, but that's about it. And that really sucked for me, because I don't have a lot of money, but I thank you guys for experimenting, but please don't experiment on my money. Make sure your label is true and make sure you test it out. On a lot of different skins

avis.titre: Don't listen to the negative comments, use own judgement
avis.texte: Is this product perfect? No. But does it work. Yes. You absolutely have to use it as intended though, right after a cleanse with a bare, dry face. Then follow up with skincare. If not it will just peel around the edges, won't lay right under makeup at all, and look terrible like most of the 1 star reviews said that almost dissuaded me from purchasing. Once I used it as the instructions on the box advised I was confused on what they were talking about and realized they probably put it on after their skincare routine like I foolishly did the first time as for similar results. It will begin to peel towards the end of the day even if applied properly, but you get a lot of use before then. Once it begins to peel makeup buffs out on the spot left behind easily, even just with a fingertip in the bathroom mirror. If your struggling with acne bad and trying to look for a solution to keep wearing makeup while hopefully helping your skin get better, i really reccomend. When your dealing with really bad acne it can ruin your confidence. Makeup doesnt lay or look right, you feel exposed or ugly without it. This helps you to feel better about wearing makeup overtop of acne, ive found sometimes it lays smoother too. Not always, but if your acne already looks a little cakey under makeup whats the difference. If you keep your expectations realistic and use as instructed i would reccomend this product and since using my acne has gotten better and i stopped using for awhile because of it. Truly

I really wanted this to work. I love the concept of an invisible make-your-own-size blemish patch but this is just not do-able. If dries slow enough to where I need to put a paper towel over the mark after washing my face because my skin can't handle being unmoisturized even if it's just 10 minutes. So that's the first issue. Second issue is the difficulty in using the tube to put out an amount that is not too much and not too little. Third issue is, since I don't wear makeup, it is blatantly obvious that I have something on. Fourth issue is that it peels off too quickly.

This does not work like the hydrocolloid patches. It protects the blemish and you can apply makeup over it, but it does not seem to help it heal. It actually starts to peel just a few hours after application which looks worse than the blemish. Big disappointment.

avis.titre: Love the idea, but doesn't work
avis.texte: I thought the idea of this product was really great and innovative, but the execution was not good. It peels very easily without any products layered on top and it's even worse with makeup on top. Don't waste your money.

avis.titre: It's good, but peels later in the day
avis.texte: I really like this when I first used it because it seemed to protect the blemish and not allow the makeup to make the blemish worse. But by late afternoon early evening, it does start to peel off and it looks like you had a sunburn and it's peeling.

I attempted to wear it underneath makeup and I put a super sticky/tacky primer over it and the primer removed the "patch". Its not a huge deal breaker for me since I typically don't wear makeup all of the time but if you are someone who likes tacky primers you might want to avoid using it. Other than that, I like it. I'll continue using it and I feel like it does what it is supposed to do!

avis.titre: Game-changer for makeup wearers with acne!
avis.texte: I'm thrilled to have received this product to try. If I hadn't, I might have never discovered how much I needed it in my routine. I'll definitely be purchasing this again and again. Hero Cosmetics Mighty Shield is a game-changer for acne and blemish sufferers who wear makeup and/or sunscreen. Applying makeup and sunscreen over breakouts is a sure way to worsen them. I applied this liquid to the blemish, it dried fairly quickly, and was super easy to put my other products over without being able to see it at all!! Not only did my acne get concealed but it was treated as if I were wearing an actual pimple patch. I highly recommend this product! I received a sample of this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

I used Mighty Shield on a day when I had an active pimple, and it made things so much easier. Once it dried, it smoothed the area just enough that my makeup could go on without catching on the texture. Normally, applying makeup over a breakout is frustrating and never looks quite right, but this gave me a flatter surface to work with and the end result looked noticeably better. It dries down clear, feels lightweight, and stays out of the way. For me, it worked exactly as a shield — nothing dramatic, just a simple layer that kept the spot protected and made my makeup routine less stressful. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

avis.titre: This Will Be A Daily Use Product For Sure!
avis.texte: I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. So I have only used it twice so far but this blemish protectant is great. It doesn't replace pimple patches entirely, but I have been using it on my inflamed and popped acne for work. My coworker swears she can't even tell I'm wearing it. It's stopped me from touching my face 100% and stops anything from like bleeding or oozing. It says you can wear it under makeup and skincare but I have to be extra gentle when applying moisturizer or it'll start to peel up the edges. I tried under some super light color corrector today and it was a bit too dry but I'm sure if I wanted to do full makeup application I could make it work. I really like the idea of wearing it as a base so my skin doesn't react to the makeup! Usually my acne will flair up if I wear too much makeup so it seems like a really good solution. I have had 0 negative reactions to it which is usually my concern with new products. I think it's perfect for me to skip pimple patches during the day at least! I have full intentions of making this a daily use product for me.

For the Mighty Shield Invisible Blemish Protectant, the ingredients include polyurethane and ethyl alcohol. The clear formula goes from a liquid to a patch form within a minute or so, and acts similar to a liquid bandage. I like the angled applicator because it's soft against my skin. However, after gently squeezing the tube, I ended up with a larger than necessary blob on the tip. I used the protectant on a stubborn spot on my shoulder, as well as on the top of my hand, between my knuckles. The alcohol smell isn't great, but dissipates after drying. Since it's hard to get the right amount out of the tube and to make a thin layer on your skin, the protectant can peel up faster than it should. I didn't love this product, but it's an option to use when you can't get normal patches to stay in place.

avis.titre: Peels Too Easily, Makeup Does NOT Cover Well Enough
avis.texte: The new Mighty Shield, by Hero Cosmetics, is a gel to cover blemishes. At first I thought it was sort of make your own hydrocolloid patch, which would have been so cool, but I was mistaken. Instead it is a liquid blemish shield that protects pimples under makeup to protect them from dirt and bacteria. I apply to clean, dry skin. It is sort of a thin clear gel that dries down after a minute or two. It can be used under makeup. My foundation doesn't want to stick to it well enough to cover it though and so I can still see it on my skin during the day. I also find it can be a bit tricky to use without peeling the product's edges. I can wear it all day and then peel it off, kind of like peeling glue off your fingers as a kid. It works ok, but if I touch my face at all the edges can begin to peel off. This is quite a unique product. It does not suck out the gunk like hydrocolloid patches do, but just protects the skin underneath. I received a free product in exchange for my honest review.

I would recommend this product to my family, friends, or anyone.
